- When Qin Shu Wangdi ordered 'every third man in the empire pressed into service' for the Wall, thousands died of 'exposure, exhaustion, and starvation'—so imperial ambition demands human cost.
- When Genghis Khan 'swept down upon China like devils loosed out of hell' across the Wall, it revealed the structure's military futility—so defense fails against psychological terror.
